questionEn: Which rationale on the topic “Substance and its properties” is chemically correct?
questionUz: “Modda va uning xossalari” mavzusidagi qaysi asos kimyoviy jihatdan to‘g‘ri?
choicesEn: A collection of particles (molecules, atoms or ions) with certain physical and chemical properties
choicesUz: Muayyan fizik va kimyoviy xususiyatlarga ega bo'lgan zarralar (molekulalar, atomlar yoki ionlar) to'plami
explanationEn: Matter is a collection of particles with certain properties.
explanationUz: Materiya ma'lum xususiyatlarga ega bo'lgan zarralar to'plamidir.
